title: Trackit
description: Real-time Linux system monitor parsing /proc filesystem directly. Sub-second polling, 1.3% CPU footprint, live scrolling graphs for CPU, memory, network, and process metrics.

title: Panopteez
description: End-to-end metrics pipeline: C++ agents stream CPU/network/process data to a Node/Express collector via authenticated HTTP API, stored in PostgreSQL. Containerised 5-agent topology with Docker Compose.

title: AI Farmers Assistant (SIH 2025)
description: AI-powered web platform with LLM chatbot for farmers — compares live market prices and delivers crop suggestions. Led a team of 6 to ship the full prototype.
